title: GHA: Update dependency awslabs/aws-lc to v1.66.2
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|
| [awslabs/aws-lc](https://redirect.github.com/awslabs/aws-lc) | minor | `1.65.1` → `1.66.2` |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>awslabs/aws-lc (awslabs/aws-lc)</summary>

### [`v1.66.2`](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/releases/tag/v1.66.2)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/awslabs/aws-lc/compare/v1.66.1...v1.66.2)

##### What's Changed

- Speed up legacy AVX CI by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2876](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2876)
- Fix incorrect assembler directive in AArch64 code by [@​awshkulkar](https://redirect.github.com/awshkulkar) in [aws#2910](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2910)
- Fix the libwebsockets integration test script by [@​dkostic](https://redirect.github.com/dkostic) in [aws#2912](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2912)
- Remove pkcs8 expected in test by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2924](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2924)
- Add randomized unit testing for EVP\_CIPHERs by [@​dkostic](https://redirect.github.com/dkostic) in [aws#2922](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2922)
- fix(target): fix mipseb 64bit compile by [@​cathaysia](https://redirect.github.com/cathaysia) in [aws#2923](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2923)
- Consolidate FORMAT\_DER/PEM in tool-openssl by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2929](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2929)
- Replace password string with proper class by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2925](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2925)
- Fix ppc64le; Improve platform detection by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2926](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2926)
- Prepare v1.66.2 by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2930](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2930)

##### New Contributors

- [@​awshkulkar](https://redirect.github.com/awshkulkar) made their first contribution in [aws#2910](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2910)
- [@​cathaysia](https://redirect.github.com/cathaysia) made their first contribution in [aws#2923](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2923)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/compare/v1.66.1...v1.66.2>

### [`v1.66.1`](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/releases/tag/v1.66.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/awslabs/aws-lc/compare/v1.66.0...v1.66.1)

##### What's Changed

- Iterate through all DNS entries in connect CLI by [@​geedo0](https://redirect.github.com/geedo0) in [aws#2906](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2906)
- Fix socat integration test by [@​dkostic](https://redirect.github.com/dkostic) in [aws#2911](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2911)
- Remove OPENSSL\_NO\_BF for real by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2914](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2914)
- Add openssl genpkey cli utility tool by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2907](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2907)
- Add stdin support for pkcs8 tool by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2915](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2915)
- Fix extension processing order in x509 cli by [@​nhatnghiho](https://redirect.github.com/nhatnghiho) in [aws#2916](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2916)
- ML-DSA: Missing Private Key Validation Checks by [@​sgmenda](https://redirect.github.com/sgmenda) in [aws#2874](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2874)
- Prepare v1.66.1 by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2918](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2918)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/compare/v1.66.0...v1.66.1>

### [`v1.66.0`](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/releases/tag/v1.66.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/awslabs/aws-lc/compare/v1.65.1...v1.66.0)

##### What's Changed

- Add encap/decapKeyCheck support in ACVP by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2872](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2872)
- Clarify comments and API behaviour for equal-preference for TLS 1.3  by [@​torben-hansen](https://redirect.github.com/torben-hansen) in [aws#2873](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2873)
- Add support for external contexts in ML-DSA ACVP by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2880](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2880)
- Route ML-DSA ACVP to the right APIs by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2884](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2884)
- Add sha1 CLI by [@​nhatnghiho](https://redirect.github.com/nhatnghiho) in [aws#2885](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2885)
- Fix openssl comparison tests by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2888](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2888)
- tool-openssl: pkcs8 error output on decrypt by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2883](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2883)
- Add RSA\_X931\_PADDING to rsa.h by [@​justsmth](https://redirect.github.com/justsmth) in [aws#2889](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2889)
- Bump urllib3 from 2.5.0 to 2.6.0 in /tests/ci by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [aws#2886](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2886)
- Run ACCP integration tests on aarch64 by [@​WillChilds-Klein](https://redirect.github.com/WillChilds-Klein) in [aws#2894](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2894)
- Blowfish OFB Block Cipher Mode Support by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2892](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2892)
- Support stdin for openssl rsa tool by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2899](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2899)
- Remove rsa expected in test by [@​samuel40791765](https://redirect.github.com/samuel40791765) in [aws#2901](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2901)
- \[tool-openssl] basic asn1parse support by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2882](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2882)
- Several CLI Fixes by [@​nhatnghiho](https://redirect.github.com/nhatnghiho) in [aws#2898](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2898)
- Implement enc CLI by [@​nhatnghiho](https://redirect.github.com/nhatnghiho) in [aws#2877](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2877)
- Prepare v1.66.0 release by [@​skmcgrail](https://redirect.github.com/skmcgrail) in [aws#2900](https://redirect.github.com/aws/aws-lc/pull/2900)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/compare/v1.65.1...v1.66.0>

</details>
